meaning.en: A monitor, television, or projector that displays an image using a cathode-ray tube.

meaning.en: (computing) A monitor that uses a cathrode ray tube.

(điện tử) Tính khởi tạo của ống tia âm cực.
(phần mềm) Khởi tạo của C. Thời gian chạy.

sentences.en: The captured images are displayed on a CRT calibrated by the tristimulus colorimeter.

sentences.en: Starting with the iMac in 1997, the range of computers aimed at home users always had inbuilt CRT or LCD displays.

sentences.en: Applications include intelligent CRT terminals, information display systems and video games.

sentences.en: An image is created on the CRT surface by varying the electron beam intensity for each pixel.
